title: Men in suits arrive by helicopter and take the Princeton's radar data
summary: Merrick von Renenamp tells of Men in suits arrive by helicopter and take the Princeton's radar data, about 2004 at USS Princeton, Pacific Ocean, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: sailors aboard the Princeton I think that um people in suits landed in helicopters and took all the radar data.

plain: Merrick von Renenamp, speaking on a podcast, relays what sailors aboard the USS Princeton, a US Navy warship in the Pacific, have said about 2004, when the ship tracked unexplained objects. He cites a sailor, Gary Voorhis, and says that men in suits landed by helicopter and took away all of the ship's radar data. If true, it would mean the records of the sighting were deliberately removed.
